_comment: Exemptions from the V1 word ban (docs/DESIGN_V2.md section 2.1). Every entry needs a reason; adding one is an owner-approved change logged in section 10. 'allowed_exact_strings' are required negated disclaimers matched as a WHOLE string (whitespace normalised); it is empty because the wording cleanup rewrote the disclaimers instead. 'third_party_product_names' are a third party's proper nouns that contain a banned word: the exact phrase (case-sensitive, whole phrase) is ignored wherever it appears, and any other banned word in the same string is still reported.

third_party_product_names.name: Microsoft Safe Links
third_party_product_names.reason: The name of Microsoft's link-rewriting service, shown because it is the platform a link is hosted on (shared_platforms.json). It is a third party's product name, not the app's own wording, so renaming it would misname the product the analyst is looking at.
